import os,json,stat,subprocess,tempfile,time,http.client
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/srv/projects/pink-iptv')
PRIVATE=ROOT/'private/systemd-env'
MAIN=Path('/etc/systemd/system/pink-iptv-backend.service')
VPN=Path('/etc/systemd/system/pink-iptv-backend.service.d/052-vpn.conf')
TARGETS={MAIN:[('EnvironmentFile=/etc/pink-iptv/backend.env','EnvironmentFile='+str(PRIVATE/'backend.env')),('EnvironmentFile=/etc/pink-iptv/secrets.env','EnvironmentFile='+str(PRIVATE/'secrets.env'))],VPN:[('EnvironmentFile=/etc/pink-iptv/vpn.env','EnvironmentFile='+str(PRIVATE/'vpn.env'))]}
SVC=('ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads')
out={'project':'pink-iptv','status':'PRECHECK','unit_changes':0,'rollback':False,'vpn_service_untouched':True,'central_vault_untouched':True}
changed=[];backup={}
def sys(args,timeout=22):
 a=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 return a.returncode
def active():return {s:sys(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet',s])==0 for s in SVC}
def http():
 try:
  conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',8010,timeout=6)
  conn.request('GET','/')
  ret=conn.getresponse().status;conn.close()
  return ret
 except Exception:return 0
def healthy(expected,tries=12):
 for _ in range(tries):
  if sys(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet','pink-iptv-backend'])==0:
   got=http()
   if got and 200<=got<500 and (expected is None or got==expected):return got
  time.sleep(2)
 return 0
def atomic(path,buf,st):
 fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.pink-private-env-',dir=path.parent)
 try:
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as w:w.write(buf);w.flush();os.fsync(w.fileno())
  os.chmod(tmp,stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode));os.chown(tmp,st.st_uid,st.st_gid)
  os.replace(tmp,path)
 finally:
  if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
try:
 assert os.geteuid()==0 and PRIVATE.is_dir() and not PRIVATE.is_symlink()
 for k in ('backend.env','secrets.env','vpn.env'):
  src=Path('/etc/pink-iptv')/k
  dst=PRIVATE/k
  assert src.is_file() and dst.is_file() and not src.is_symlink() and not dst.is_symlink()
  assert src.read_bytes()==dst.read_bytes(),'staged content differs from source'
 pre=active();assert all(pre.values()),'essential service not fully active'
 baseline=healthy(None,6)
 assert baseline!=0,'PINK baseline HTTP not responding'
 for unit,mappings in TARGETS.items():
  assert unit.is_file() and not unit.is_symlink()
  buf=unit.read_bytes()
  txt=buf.decode('utf-8')
  for fr,to in mappings:
   assert txt.count(fr)==1,'unexpected service environment layout'
   txt=txt.replace(fr,to)
  assert txt!=buf.decode()
  save=PRIVATE/('.'+unit.name+'.before-private-env-20261104')
  assert not save.exists() and not save.is_symlink(),'unit backup conflict'
  backup[unit]=(buf,unit.stat(),save,txt.encode())
 for unit,(buf,st,save,new) in backup.items():
  fd=os.open(save,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(buf);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
  atomic(unit,new,st);changed.append(unit)
 out['unit_changes']=len(changed)
 assert sys(['systemd-analyze','verify',str(MAIN)],30)==0,'systemd verification failed'
 assert sys(['systemctl','daemon-reload'],30)==0,'reload failed'
 assert sys(['systemctl','restart','pink-iptv-backend'],50)==0,'backend restart failed'
 post=healthy(baseline,14)
 assert post!=0,'backend HTTP changed or unavailable'
 assert all(active().values()),'critical service lost active status'
 for p,(_,_,_,new) in backup.items():assert p.read_bytes()==new
 out.update({'status':'SWITCHED_AND_TESTED','backend_http_status':post,'nine_services_active':True,'new_env_paths':True})
except Exception as e:
 out.update({'status':'FAILED_WITH_RESTORE_ATTEMPT','reason':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:175]})
 if changed:
  try:
   for unit in reversed(changed):
    old,meta,save,_=backup[unit]
    atomic(unit,old,meta)
   sys(['systemctl','daemon-reload'],30)
   sys(['systemctl','restart','pink-iptv-backend'],50)
   out['rollback']=True
   out['backend_running_after_rollback']=sys(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet','pink-iptv-backend'])==0
  except Exception as err:out['rollback_issue']=type(err).__name__
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
